These two 16×16 RGB gradient references are copied byte-for-byte from
imazen/zenextras at 109a9ec367278a93751f7701f8536358e5d3f5cd,
zenjp2/tests/fixtures. That project records Pillow/OpenJPEG as their encoder.
They are existing reference-decoder fixtures, not product encoding output.
The independent pixel oracle is R=16x, G=16y, B=8(x+y).
